name: @kernloop/faculty-models
description: Kernloop Layer 2 — the models faculty (spec §5.7/§8.4). The SUPPLY dual of ModelRequirement: a pure, layered resolveIdentity (table→rule→unknown) that normalizes a served model alias/id into a ModelIdentity, backed by a vendored models.dev-pattern catalog snapshot. No network, no model call — discovery via /v1/models is a later phase.
